sloka: राक्षस्यो विविध आकारा विरूपा विकृताः तथा ।दृष्टा हनूमता तत्र न तु सा जनक आत्मजा ॥५-१२-१९॥
transliteration: rākṣasyo vividha ākārā virūpā vikṛtāḥ tathā ।dṛṣṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu sā janaka ātmajā ॥5-12-19॥

translations.english: Hanuman could see only ogresses of different typesugly, deformed but could not find the daughter of Janaka.
